0022600120.text: The Cavaliers (1-1, 3rd in the Central, 1.5 games back, 9th in the East) host the Timberwolves (3-0, 3rd in the Northwest, 6th in the West), who have won three straight. Minnesota is missing Donte DiVincenzo, who is out with an Achilles injury after surgery, and Anthony Edwards is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and Cleveland won their last meeting 146-134 on January 10, 2026, in Cleveland.
